name: rosetta-evolutionary-algorithm
code:
use default
use System.Random

let target = "METHINKS IT IS LIKE A WEASEL"
let letters = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ "
let c = 100
let rate = 0.05
let random = Random(3)

random_letter() -> char => letters[random.next(letters.length)]

fitness(candidate: string) -> int =>
    (0..target.length) |> filter(i => candidate[i] == target[i]) |> count()

mutate(parent: string, rate: double) -> string =>
    string(
        parent
            |> map(letter =>
                if random.next_double() < rate then random_letter()
                else letter
                fi)
            |> collect_array())

let parent mut =
    string(
        (0..target.length) |> map(_ => random_letter()) |> collect_array())

let generation mut = 0

while parent !~ target do
    generation = generation + 1

    let fittest =
        (0..c)
            |> map(_ => mutate(parent, rate))
            |> reduce(parent, (best, copy) =>
                if fitness(copy) > fitness(best) then copy else best fi)

    if fitness(fittest) > fitness(parent) then
        write_line("{generation,4}: {fittest} ({fitness(fittest)})")
    fi

    parent = fittest
od
